note: Issue #29: reminders that the AI characters are not real people. Read by src/systems/llm/disclaimers.gd. Issue #328: 'ask' is the first launch's question (AI characters on or off; off is the default and Enter's answer), 'status' the loading/ready line, 'offline' the one line a conversation gets when the AI is on but no model answered ('still_loading' when nothing failed and a model is still loading). 'launch' is shown once each time the game starts while AI characters are on; 'talk' sits at the top of every conversation; 'repeat' is posted again in the conversation whenever the player's message contains a trigger. Triggers match whole words, also with s, es, d, ed, ing, er or ers on the end (so 'kill' catches 'kills', 'killing' and 'killer' but not 'skill'); a trigger with a space matches that phrase. %s is the character's name.

launch.title: Before you play
launch.text:
Some characters in this game are run by AI. What they say is generated by a computer program as you talk to them. They are not real people, they do not know you, and they can be wrong, strange or inconsistent.

Do not rely on them for advice about your real life. If anything they say upsets you, step away and talk to someone you trust.

ask.title: AI characters?
ask.text:
Some characters can be run by AI: they answer whatever you type, in their own words. It needs a model on this computer or a cloud API key, and you can change your mind any time in Settings (F10).

The whole story plays without it: with AI off, characters talk from a menu of topics with written lines.

offline: AI offline: %s. Written lines for now; F10 to fix.
still_loading: The AI model is still loading: written lines for now, and the next thing you say tries it again.
talk: %s is an AI character. Replies are generated by a computer and can be wrong. Not a real person.
repeat: Reminder: %s is an AI character in a game, not a real person, and cannot help with real-life problems. If you are thinking about hurting yourself or someone else, please reach out to someone you trust or a local crisis line.
